headline: 3 Reasons to Sell DLTR and 1 Stock to Buy Instead
summary: Dollar Tree has followed the market’s trajectory closely, rising in tandem with the S&P 500 over the past six months. The stock has climbed by 6.3% to $127.21 per share while the index has gained 8.3%.
